SignedIn sends no event (SignInViewModel.kt:42). TmrToastState is remembered in TmrShell (TmrApp.kt:153), which sits inside key(ready.accountId) (TmrApp.kt:95). The re-root drops any visible cancelled toast, and keepOnly (TmrApp.kt:78) clears the VM along with its Channel. No event or toast crosses an account change.
The VM still writes nothing. The Channel carries Unit only (SignInViewModel.kt:28-30), and cancelKeepsNoData is unchanged.

Each failed attempt sends one event (SignInViewModel.kt:42-45). SignInRoute collects it in LaunchedEffect(viewModel) (SignInScreen.kt:75-77). TmrToastState.show does not suspend or queue (TmrToast.kt:82-94), so nothing replays later. retryTapCallsSignInTwiceTotal now asserts the toast after Retry with a synchronous gateway. rotationDoesNotShowTheToastAgain re-keys the composition with the same VM and asserts no toast. Both would fail on the old LaunchedEffect(uiState). An attempt that ends during a rotation gap is buffered and shown once on the new collector. A cancelled attempt cannot surface after a later success: the success path sends nothing, and the toast state dies with the re-keyed root.
CancellationException is still rethrown (SignInViewModel.kt:37-38). The diff adds no logging. The event payload is Unit, so it carries no PII.

SignInStories.kt now draws the '1 page' sticker only at fontScale <= 1.3 (ONE_PAGE_STICKER_MAX_FONT_SCALE). I opened the re-recorded signin_story3_narrow-337-font-200_dark.png at d9c2144c: no sticker sits under Paige, and the headline, subline and button wrap with no ellipsis.
